a.title: A collection of data, published or curated by a single agent, and available for access or download in one or more representations.
a.xlink:title: A collection of data, published or curated by a single agent, and available for access or download in one or more representations.

a.title: An Entity that is being evaluated in a DataGeneratingActivity.
a.xlink:title: An Entity that is being evaluated in a DataGeneratingActivity.

a.title: An activity or process that is being evaluated in a DataGeneratingActivity.
a.xlink:title: An activity or process that is being evaluated in a DataGeneratingActivity.

a.title: An Activity (process) that has the objective to produce information (in form of a dataset) about another Activity or Entity.
a.xlink:title: An Activity (process) that has the objective to produce information (in form of a dataset) about another Activity or Entity.

a.title: A Dataset that was generated by an analysis of some previously generated data. For example, a dataset that contains the data of an assignment of a chemical structure to a sample based on the spectral data obtained from the sample is an AnalyticalDataset.
